auth.error.unauthorizedDomain: This site's domain isn't approved in Firebase yet. An owner must add it under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains — then Google sign-in will work.
auth.error.operationNotAllowed: Google sign-in is disabled for this project. Enable it in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.
auth.error.network: Network problem during sign-in. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.badCredentials: Wrong email or password. Try again.
auth.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.error.invalidApiKey: App config missing (invalid API key). The deployment was built without Firebase secrets — rebuild with VITE_FIREBASE_* set.
auth.error.userDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact support.
auth.error.accountExists: An account already exists with a different sign-in method. Try the other method.
auth.error.popupBlocked: Sign-in popup was blocked. Allow popups or use Google redirect.
auth.error.storageBlocked: Your browser blocked sign-in storage (Tracking Prevention). Allow cookies and site data for this site plus apis.google.com, then try again. Edge: Settings -> Privacy -> Tracking prevention -> Exceptions. Chrome: Settings -> Privacy -> Third-party cookies -> Allow.

landing.hero.sub: HSC Crackers turns the NCTB syllabus into a map — first study, three spaced revisions, a server-verified focus timer, and a pace forecast that tells you today whether you'll finish in time.
landing.hero.stageHint: drag the sky · four rings, four passes over each chapter
landing.walk.title: One screen for the whole war.
landing.walk.lede: Scroll through the three things that actually decide your result.
landing.walk.step1.title: A timer that can't be cheated
landing.walk.step1.body: Focus sessions are validated on the server, so every minute on the leaderboard is a minute somebody actually studied. Pause freely — paused time never counts.
landing.walk.step2.title: The whole syllabus, one map
landing.walk.step2.body: Every subject, every chapter — each with four boxes: first study and three revisions. Tick one, and the next revision schedules itself.
landing.walk.step3.title: Pace you can act on
landing.walk.step3.body: A live forecast compares your coverage with your exam date and names the chapters-per-day that puts you back on track. Streaks and batch ranks keep the fire lit.
landing.method.title: Study once. Revise thrice.
landing.method.body: Each chapter gets one first study and three spaced revisions — around day 3, day 10 and day 30. The gaps do the work: every successful recall burns the chapter in deeper.
landing.method.body2: No app can study for you. This one makes sure you don't forget.
landing.method.aria: Revision timeline: first study on day 0, revisions on days 3, 10 and 30
landing.feat1.title: Minutes that mean something
landing.feat1.body: Sessions run on a server clock, not a console command. What you did is what you did — and the leaderboard respects it.
landing.feat2.title: Load shedding? Keep studying.
landing.feat2.body: The timer keeps counting when the network drops and submits the session the moment it's back. Your streak never dies to a power cut.
landing.feat3.title: Bangla first, not Bangla also
landing.feat3.body: Syllabus, tasks and timer are built in Bangla from the start — English is a switch, not the default you escape to.
landing.pricing.title: ৳50 a month. No card, ever.
landing.pricing.lede: Every account starts with a 7-day free trial. When it ends, pay with bKash and keep going — cancel by simply not renewing.
landing.pricing.bkashNote: No cards, no gates, no subscriptions that renew themselves. You send a payment, we flip the switch.
landing.pricing.step1.title: Send the payment
landing.pricing.step1.body: bKash the plan price to the number shown in the app.
landing.pricing.step2.title: Paste the TrxID
landing.pricing.step2.body: Copy the transaction ID from your bKash SMS into the subscribe screen.
landing.pricing.step3.title: Approved, usually same day
landing.pricing.step3.body: A human reviews each request — no bots holding your money.
landing.final.title: Start tonight.
landing.final.echo: তোমার নক্ষত্রমণ্ডল শুরু হবে একটা তারা দিয়ে।
landing.final.sub: The syllabus isn't going to shrink. Your constellation starts with one star.
landing.footer.blurb: A study tracker for HSC finalists — syllabus, revisions, pace, streak.
